_comment: The shared console definition. The GUI and the CLI both read this file, so a button the operator presses and a command an agent sends are the same string from the same place. Edit this, not either client.
_verified: Every command below was read out of the board's own 'help' on 2026-09-09, firmware 1.0.3-ge423d9845154-dirty on T-Display-P4 5C84301528. An earlier version of this file was written from guesses and about a third of it was wrong. If you add one, run 'help' and copy the real syntax rather than assuming. The RADIO LINK, TIME and ACTIONS groups were added 2026-09-09 and every command in them was exercised on hardware - see bench/HARDWARE_2026-09-09.md for what each one printed.

buttons.label: HELP
buttons.help: Every registered command. The only authority on what this build has.

buttons.label: VERSION
buttons.help: Firmware, board, IDF. Its timestamp is the version TU's compile time, NOT the image's - identify an image by app SHA256.

buttons.label: STATUS
buttons.help: Mode, freq, volume, gain, mute, heap - the one-line answer to 'what is it doing'.

buttons.label: SAFEMODE
buttons.help: Boot health, failed-start count, whether a coredump is stored.

buttons.label: HEAP
buttons.help: Internal/DMA/PSRAM free, USB IQ slots, NVS write stats.

buttons.label: DATE
buttons.help: Wall clock, or an uptime marker when time has never been synced.

buttons.label: STATS
buttons.help: NVS write counters. dropped>0 means settings changes are being shed.

buttons.label: TUI ON
buttons.help: Take the screen. Holds it and the LVGL lock until 'tui off'.

buttons.label: TUI OFF
buttons.help: Give the screen back to LVGL.

buttons.label: ROTATE
buttons.help: Turn the TUI 90 degrees. The session restarts to pick up the new grid.

groups.name: KEYS
groups._comment: Injected keys. This is how the interface is driven with no keyboard attached, which is the normal state of this board.

buttons.label: P25
buttons.help: Switch the radio to P25.

buttons.label: RTL
buttons.help: Dongle health. 'rtl detach' simulates an unplug.

buttons.label: SPEC
buttons.help: Strongest bins of the FM SWEEP spectrum.

buttons.label: TEL
buttons.help: One telemetry frame - the same fields the Flipper head reads.

buttons.label: ACARS
buttons.help: ACARS is an FM submode, not a top-level mode. 'fl MODE ACARS' is invalid.

buttons.label: SWEEP
buttons.help: Band power sweep - this is what feeds the shared waterfall's FM source.

buttons.label: BEEP
buttons.help: Boot chime. Proves I2C, I2S and the codec path in one command.

buttons.label: MUTE
buttons.help: Toggles - it is not a query.

buttons.label: VOL
buttons.help: Prints volume AND mute state.

buttons.label: I2C
buttons.help: Scan both buses. This is how the absent touch controller was found.

buttons.label: KEYS
buttons.help: Keypad probe. 'keys watch' prints events for ten seconds.

buttons.label: LORA
buttons.help: Bring the SX1262 up and report what answered. The packet path is under RADIO LINK.

buttons.label: CRASH
buttons.help: Bounded stored-dump metadata. Does not decode on device and does not erase.

groups.name: RADIO LINK
groups._comment: SX1262 LoRa packet path (LS-967) and MeshCore (LS-969). Defaults are US915 910.525 MHz SF8 BW62.5k CR4/5 sync 0x12 - MeshCore's own settings. NOTE: MeshCore takes exclusive ownership of the radio once started, so 'lora rx' is refused while it runs; that is LS-970 and it is deliberate.

buttons.label: LORA CFG
buttons.help: Configure at the US915 defaults and report airtime for 16 bytes.

buttons.label: LORA RX 10
buttons.help: Listen for 10 s and report packets, errors and the measured noise floor. A healthy floor here is around -115 dBm.

buttons.label: LORA TX
buttons.help: TRANSMITS. Sends one plain LoRa frame so the path can be proved against a second radio.

buttons.label: MESH START
buttons.help: Bring MeshCore up in the background. Receive only - transmit is disarmed at every boot.

buttons.label: MESH
buttons.help: Node id, whether transmit is armed, dispatcher loop count, packet and airtime counters.

buttons.label: MESH TX ON
buttons.help: ARMS TRANSMIT. Not persisted - it is off again after any reboot.

buttons.label: MESH TX OFF
buttons.help: Disarm transmit.

buttons.label: ADVERT
buttons.help: TRANSMITS. Floods a signed self-advert. Refused unless transmit is armed.

buttons.label: MESH STOP
buttons.help: Stop the background task and give the radio back.

groups.name: TIME
groups._comment: PCF8563 RTC (LS-968). The board boots with a real wall clock from this part, with no network.

buttons.label: RTC
buttons.help: Read the RTC. Says explicitly when the oscillator has stopped, rather than reporting a stale count as a date.

buttons.label: RTC SYNC
buttons.help: Store the current system clock into the RTC so it survives the next power cycle.

buttons.label: DATE
buttons.help: Wall clock, or an uptime marker when time has never been set.

groups.name: ACTIONS
groups._comment: The named action registry (LS-966). This is the same dispatch a user app on the SD card uses, so a button here and a .lsapp binding cannot disagree. Bare 'call' lists everything the running firmware offers, which is the only listing that cannot go stale.

buttons.label: LIST
buttons.help: Every registered action with its signature and the capability it needs.

presets.label: Boot health
presets.help: What state did it come up in, and is anything stored from last time.

presets.label: Start the TUI
presets.help: Take the screen and land on the directory.

presets.label: Walk the directory
presets.help: Drive the launcher with no keyboard: move, then open.

presets.label: Landscape touch test
presets.help: Turn to landscape and open the waterfall, which is the screen with the most buttons to tap.

presets.label: Portrait touch test
presets.help: Back to portrait and onto the directory, where the tiles are the biggest targets.

presets.label: Waterfall on FM sweep
presets.help: Give the shared waterfall a real source, then open it.

presets.label: Receiver snapshot
presets.help: Everything read-only about what the radio is doing now.

presets.label: Speaker and screen alive
presets.help: Two commands that prove the codec path and the panel independently.

presets.label: Hardware roll call
presets.help: What actually answered on this board.

presets.label: MeshCore up (receive only)
presets.help: Start the stack and show what it is. Transmit stays disarmed.

presets.label: LoRa receiver check
presets.help: Configure and listen. A floor near -115 dBm means the receive chain is alive; 0 packets is expected with nothing transmitting.

presets.label: Clock and radio roll call
presets.help: The parts brought up on 2026-09-09, in one pass.
